$comment: flow topology (source of truth once FLOW_GRAPH_EXECUTOR defaults on). Trusted data: loads ONLY from the skill install dir, pin-verified against harness/pins/flow-topology.sha256 (canonical-JSON sha256; regenerate via the command in harness/README.md). cmd is an argv ARRAY (no shell) restricted to the read-only `gate` verb; mutating verbs are lint-banned. Debt-skips are a plan_next traversal semantic (skipped gate = accepted-with-debt) - NO bypass edges belong here. EVERY card edge below is a transition the runner actually emits: dispatch (workspace add) -> review (check) -> merge (workspace remove), with an optional verify-live between review and merge when the operator uses `card done` instead of hand-editing status (workspace remove, executor-proved ancestry). A RED review loops back to review - the agent repairs and re-runs check, which records another review - bounded by max_visits (two strikes, then escalate per auto-run.md). card-abandon is the unmerged-teardown terminal and can follow any card node, because `workspace remove` may happen at any point. There is deliberately no card-build node: the build is LLM work with no deterministic boundary. Edit checklist: run `graph lint`, regenerate the pin, bump topology_version for semantic changes.
